mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_campaign WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
SELECT FROM marketing_campaign WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id=#{id} ORDER BY version FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_campaign SET status='PAUSED',lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED'
UPDATE marketing_campaign SET status=#{status},lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND lock_version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_campaign c WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id > #{after} AND version=(SELECT MAX(c2.version) FROM marketing_campaign c2 WHERE c2.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND c2.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) ORDER BY campaign_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM marketing_campaign WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY campaign_id LIMIT 101
